full_name: Elaine Freedgood | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Humanities Beatrice Shepherd Blane Fellow New York University
bio: Elaine Freedgood, a professor of English at New York University, is working on the general problem of facts in fiction. Theoretically, her work encompasses recent debates on fictionality and reference, on denotation, and on reading and naming.
